prerequisites: Owned lab openlaw-docs-80ceef9e-mcplan (mcplan, app 127.0.0.1:43320, mail 127.0.0.1:48445) built from the same commit with the same app and engine image IDs, Helix seed light profile, random seed 7, seeded 2026-09-25T11:50:17.612Z to 2026-09-25T11:50:51.580Z; destroyed after the walk. Instance address set as the guides say: the operator removed the BASE_URL pin; the Administrator saved Application address in Settings → Advanced → Instance address (http://[::1]:43320, then http://192.168.50.10:43320, then http://127.0.0.1:43320) and the operator restarted the API and worker after each save.

scenarios.expected: Labels and results match the article; new grants use the lifetime after restart. A plain-HTTP LAN address refuses OAuth enablement by name while keys work. Rotation invalidates the old secret without deleting grants.
scenarios.actual: Phases lan and m41 (2026-09-25T11:50:58Z to 11:53:05Z). Loopback 127.0.0.1: no pill while OAuth Clients are off; Legal Users and Business Users OAuth Clients each saved (200), separate from API keys, and the pill read Not reachable · HTTPS scheme, Public IPv4 address. On http://[::1]:43320 the switch saved and the pill read Not reachable · HTTPS scheme, IPv4 record, Public IPv4 address. On the plain-HTTP LAN address http://192.168.50.10:43320 both OAuth Clients switches were refused (PATCH 400) and stayed off, the pill read Not reachable · HTTPS scheme, Public IPv4 address, Add Client showed The Client could not be saved. Check the callback URLs and try again., Generate secret showed The Client secret could not be generated. Try again., six well-known documents returned 404, and API keys worked. Allowed Clients started open with Claude, Claude Code and ChatGPT as Published identity (metadata URL captions, no Edit) and Microsoft 365 Copilot as Registered client with No secret generated, all enabled; Enable Claude turned off and on. Edit on the template opened Edit Client with Client name, Client id (Generate a secret to create the client id.) and Callback URLs 1 and 2 read-only for Teams and vscode.dev plus an empty slot 3; http://192.168.1.5 was refused, an HTTPS slot saved, Add callback URL added slot 4. Generate secret opened Your Client secret is ready (outside click kept it open; Copy, Client name, Client id, Done); the caption became Secret generated Sep 25, 2026 and the button Rotate secret; no Delete Client on the seeded template. Add Client with a loopback callback stayed open as Edit Client, offered Delete Client, Generate secret worked and the Client started enabled. Nadia consented without Administrator approval: the consent page offered only the requested Contracts and Matters with Read only and Read and write, Allow disabled until chosen. Active keys and grants showed 0 keys · 1 grant with a 90-day Expires. Read-only, the Allowed Client switch and the Legal Users OAuth Clients switch applied to the grant's next request (write Tools dropped; 401; 401; back to 200). Rotate secret kept the Client id; refresh with the old secret returned 400 invalid_client, the grant count stayed 1, the new secret refreshed and connected. Dynamic client registration on: discovery advertised /api/auth/oauth2/register and a self-registered native Client appeared as Registered by the Client, enabled; off: discovery dropped the endpoint, a new registration got 403 Dynamic Client registration is disabled., the existing entry stayed enabled; Delete Client removed it. Revoke on the grant opened Revoke OAuth grant; its token got 401 and refresh failed. OAuth grant lifetime (days) 7 saved with Settings saved. Restart the API and worker to apply changes.; a grant before the restart got 90 days; after restart Nadia's new grant got 7 days (Oct 2, 2026) while Daniel's earlier grant kept Dec 24, 2026 through a refresh. Nadia's Connected Clients Disconnect opened Revoke OAuth grant and the grant stopped (401). Delete Client removed the entry and its remaining grant (401).

limitations: The Reachable pill (all three checks passing) needs an HTTPS BASE_URL with a public IPv4 record; the labs are loopback only, so only the Not reachable states were observed: HTTPS scheme and Public IPv4 address on 127.0.0.1 and the LAN address, plus IPv4 record on http://[::1].

An expired key was produced as fixture setup by moving the walkthrough's own api_keys row expiry into the past in the work2 database, because the shortest API key lifetime is one day. Expired OAuth grants were not produced; revoked grants were.

The plain-HTTP LAN case used the private address http://192.168.50.10:43320 as the Application address, reached by a loopback-only forward proxy; the lab port stayed bound to 127.0.0.1. On that origin the key-ready Copy button fails silently (product bug in walkthrough.json); the key was taken by selecting the dialog text.
OAuth consent used a registered test Client with a loopback callback. The vendor Clients (Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Microsoft 365 Copilot) were not connected; their guides cover that.
Record activity 'via the named Client' attribution for writes was not walked; the registry does not require it.

The V-M40-MCP Administrator steps ran in two work2 runs: the full m40 run and the m40r re-run of three checks that failed on a stale row read and an unfiltered Audit log read (walkthrough.json marks them supersededBy m40r).
